newsitem.title: USA: Salant says Jerald Politzer named chairman.
newsitem.headline: Salant says Jerald Politzer named chairman.

text.p: Salant Corp said on Wednesday that its directors had elected the company's chief executive officer, Jerald Politzer, as chairman.

The election followed the resignation of chairman Nicholas DiPaolo. Earlier in the year, DiPaolo stepped down from his post as president and chief executive of the company to attend to personal interests.
DiPaolo had agreed to remain as chairman of the board for a transition period, which has been successfully concluded, the company said.
Salant Corp is an apparel company that markets a line of men's apparel under brand names that include Perry Ellis, Manhattan and John Henry.
